```yaml
name: Agent Board Integration

on:
  schedule:
    - cron: '0 * * * *' # Runs every hour
  workflow_dispatch:

jobs:
  board-sync:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - name: Checkout repository
        uses: actions/checkout@v2

      - name: Set up Rust
        uses: actions-rs/toolchain@v1
        with:
          toolchain: stable
          profile: minimal
          override: true

      - name: Install dependencies
        run: cargo build --release

      - name: Sync board
        env:
          GITHUB_PROJECTS_TOKEN: ${{ secrets.GITHUB_PROJECTS_TOKEN }}
          GITHUB_TOKEN: ${{ secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN }}
        run: cargo run --release --bin agent-board-sync

  kanban-worker:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - name: Checkout repository
        uses: actions/checkout@v2

      - name: Set up Rust
        uses: actions-rs/toolchain@v1
        with:
          toolchain: stable
          profile: minimal
          override: true

      - name: Install dependencies
        run: cargo build --release

      - name: Run Kanban worker
        env:
          GITHUB_PROJECTS_TOKEN: ${{ secrets.GITHUB_PROJECTS_TOKEN }}
          GITHUB_TOKEN: ${{ secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN }}
        run: cargo run --release --bin kanban-worker
```

This workflow includes two jobs: `board-sync` which synchronizes the GitHub Projects board state, and `kanban-worker` which runs an autonomous agent to manage tasks on the board. Both jobs use the latest Ubuntu runner and set up the Rust environment using the `actions-rs/toolchain` action. The necessary dependencies are installed, and the respective binaries (`agent-board-sync` and `kanban-worker`) are executed with the required environment variables.
